why_it_matters: The LEI was not renewed on time. It still identifies the fund, but its reference data has not been re-validated within the one-year cycle, and GLEIF notes regulators increasingly check that reported LEIs are renewed. Counterparties and reporting engines often treat a lapsed record as stale.
next_action: Contact the fund's LEI issuer (or the management company) to renew; confirm the reference data.

rule_name: LEI retired, annulled or duplicate while fund is authorised
why_it_matters: The CBI register lists the fund as authorised, but GLEIF says this LEI is no longer in use (retired, annulled or flagged duplicate). Reports keyed on it would identify a dead or wrong record.
next_action: Confirm the fund's current LEI; if the fund merged or redomiciled, find the successor LEI and update master data.

rule_name: Renewal date passed but status still ISSUED
why_it_matters: The next renewal date is in the past yet the record still shows ISSUED, so the status is about to lapse or the issuer has not updated it.
next_action: Check renewal with the issuer before the record lapses.

why_it_matters: Preventive: renewing before the due date avoids the fund appearing as lapsed in counterparty checks.
next_action: Add to the renewal calendar and notify the management company.

rule_name: GLEIF entity status INACTIVE while fund is authorised
why_it_matters: GLEIF records the legal entity as no longer operating, which conflicts with the CBI register listing it as authorised. One of the two sources is out of date.
next_action: Check for revocation, merger or termination; raise a challenge with GLEIF or correct internal records.

why_it_matters: A fund authorised by the Central Bank of Ireland should carry IE as its legal jurisdiction. A different value suggests a mis-registered LEI or a mismatch to a foreign fund with the same name.
next_action: Verify the match; if correct, challenge the GLEIF record.

rule_name: Matched LEI not categorised as FUND
why_it_matters: GLEIF lets data users filter on entity category FUND. A fund registered as GENERAL is missed by such filters.
next_action: Ask the issuer to correct the entity category.

why_it_matters: GLEIF Level 2 can record the fund's main management entity (IS_FUND-MANAGED_BY). Without it, downstream users cannot link the fund to its ManCo or AIFM from LEI data alone.
next_action: Ask the management company to report the fund-manager relationship at the next renewal.

rule_name: Sub-fund without an umbrella relationship in GLEIF
why_it_matters: The CBI register lists this fund as a sub-fund, but GLEIF has no IS_SUBFUND_OF link, so the umbrella structure is not visible in LEI data.
next_action: Request the umbrella relationship at the next renewal.

rule_name: Umbrella in GLEIF differs from CBI umbrella
why_it_matters: The sub-fund's GLEIF parent umbrella is not the umbrella the CBI register shows. Structure-based reporting (for example aggregating sub-funds to the umbrella legal entity) would roll up to the wrong parent.
next_action: Confirm the umbrella with the fund administrator and correct the relationship record.

rule_name: Fund manager in GLEIF differs from CBI ManCo / AIFM
why_it_matters: The management entity in GLEIF does not match the management company or AIFM on the CBI register, often after a ManCo change. Manager-level reporting and fee or oversight attribution would be wrong.
next_action: Confirm the current ManCo or AIFM and update the relationship record. Where GLEIF names the delegate investment manager instead of the ManCo or AIFM, ask for the relationship to point at the main management entity.

rule_name: Fund name differs between CBI and GLEIF
why_it_matters: Matched only after fuzzy matching or via a former name. Name drift breaks exact-name lookups used by distributors and data vendors.
next_action: Confirm the legal name and update whichever source is stale.

rule_name: Possible duplicate LEIs for one fund
why_it_matters: More than one live (ISSUED or LAPSED) LEI carries the same fund name. Two identifiers for one fund fragment reporting and positions.
next_action: Identify the correct LEI and ask the issuer to mark the other as duplicate.

rule_name: No LEI found for an authorised fund
why_it_matters: No GLEIF record could be matched. Either the fund has no LEI (it cannot be reported as a counterparty or client where an LEI is mandatory) or its GLEIF name differs too much to match automatically.
next_action: Search GLEIF manually; if none exists, request an LEI before the fund trades.

why_it_matters: A fuzzy match scored in the review band. It is not counted as matched until a person confirms it.
next_action: Review the pair and confirm or reject.

rule_name: Issued Irish fund LEI not found on any CBI register
why_it_matters: An active, issued LEI for an Irish fund that matches nothing on the current registers. It may belong to a terminated or revoked fund whose LEI was never retired, or to a fund outside these registers.
next_action: Check whether the fund is still authorised; if terminated, ask for the LEI to be retired.

rule_name: Source record quarantined or flagged by data-quality rules
why_it_matters: A CBI register row failed a data-quality rule (for example a dated row with no fund name, or the same sub-fund name twice in one umbrella). Such rows are excluded from matching or flagged for follow-up.
next_action: Raise with the source owner; re-run after the next register edition.

rule_name: Manager name differs but brand matches (rename or translation)
why_it_matters: The GLEIF fund manager and the CBI ManCo / AIFM share the same brand name but the legal names differ, usually a renamed or translated legal name. Low risk, but exact-name lookups of the manager will fail.
next_action: Confirm it is the same legal entity; align the legal name.
